## What's Changed
- Workaround system server crash on A17

## 更新日志
- 变通处理 A17 上的系统服务崩溃

This is the last release on legacy API. Next release will be based on libxposed API 101.

这是基于旧版 API 的最后一个版本。下一个版本将基于 libxposed API 101。

- Allow disabling exact signature check

- Handle another downgrade check on A15+

# CorePatch

```
Disable signature verification For Android
禁用安装apk时候执行的签名校验
The current version support android 10-14
当前版本只支持安卓10-14
```


## Fetures 功能
```
 allow downgrade application [INSTALL_FAILED_VERSION_DOWNGRADE]
 允许降级安装应用

 allows direct install apps after modify file in apk [ignore invalid digest error etc..]
 允许安装签名错误的apk

 allow overlay install apps with inconsistent signatures
 允许在使用不同签名的情况下覆盖安装
```
